verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud hosting provider, so a published uptime SLA with downtime credits is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an SLA, uptime commitments, or service credits. Community reports of an outage describe reliability incidents, not whether a contractual SLA exists, so they neither support nor contradict this story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can review a published uptime SLA with defined credits for downtime
